questions.text: What is the primary purpose of Principal Component Analysis (PCA)?
options: To classify data into different categories
To reduce dimensionality while preserving maximum variance
To cluster similar data points together
To predict future values based on historical data
questions.explanation: PCA is a dimensionality reduction technique that transforms high-dimensional data into a lower-dimensional space while preserving as much variance (information) as possible. It finds new axes (principal components) that capture the directions of maximum variance in the data, allowing you to represent complex data with fewer features.
